text:
*You return to the Hollow Crown as the sky begins to lighten. The pieces are falling into place, and the picture they form is terrifying.*

*Harren, the head of the Merchants' Guild, is smuggling weapons into the city. The Duke is being poisoned — slowly, steadily — by his own physician, installed by the steward Goran. Veteran guards have been replaced with mercenaries. And properties along the city wall are being bought up in secret.*

*This isn't corruption. This is a coup. When the Duke finally dies, Harren will have an armed force inside the walls and a way to let more in.*

Marta: "You look like you've seen a ghost, stranger."

*You need allies. You need a plan. And you need to move fast — the Duke could die any day now.*

choices.text: Rally your allies — it's time to act together
Sneak into Harren's Guild offices for proof
Use your noble connections to call an emergency council meeting
Calculate Harren's supply chain weaknesses and plan a financial sabotage
